texts.text: <color=#515aee>Boldness... tempered by prudence...</color>
Ah... Looks like it's you and me for this floor, Outis.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Feels a bit strange, doesn't it? Having to go around with a different group on every floor.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Still, I'm glad to be partnered up with you for this floor. It's been easier for us to work together lately, so...
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: What? No, I'm not "easy" with anyone, least of all you Sinners. Ridiculous.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Riiight...
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Hey. I need to ask you something.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Though she didn't specify who, I had a pretty good guess that the "hey" in question was directed at Meursault.
Ask.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Have you been here before?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: It was the same question Ishmael had asked earlier. A reasonable one, too, as it was hard not to wonder how Meursault has so much detailed knowledge about this strange place, as though he were entirely familiar with it.
No. I have not been in here before.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Then explain just how you happen to know so much about this place.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Outis narrowed her eyes. That usually indicates that she's either suspicious of someone, or has already engaged her "interrogation mode."
... I was told about it.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Then your source was at least in a managerial position within the Grand Magasin, I'd wager. If they were just another lifer like the rest of the prisoners here, I doubt they would've had the means to reach you.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Correct.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: What was the nature of your relationship with that individual?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: The collaborative kind.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>The kind that gets... pretty steamy.</color>
Who said that?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>Sounds like I'm coming through.</color>
Just as Meursault replied...

... what I presumed to be the "Voice" the people of the Grand Magasin had mentioned began coming through with clarity. Though if I were to guess the speaker's mood, I'd say she carried... a faint note of discontent.
<color=#ebcaa2>Now seems to be as good a time as any to introduce myself.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>My name is... Jeanne. That's the name of the Voice I've so graciously chosen to share with you.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>Time to bid each other adieu.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>I know you're dying to see me, ma puce, but try to exercise some restraint for now.</color>
... Is she gone?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>... Am I?</color>
... Tsk. A familiar mischief.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>Sorry, couldn't help myself. It's not often that I get to fool around like this at work. Leaving for real now—tchao!</color>
What the hell, Meursault?!
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: The anger you display is disproportionate to the significance of the matter at hand. The explanation is simple: our romantic intimacy began during my tenure at Sisyphe System. My permanent exile from N Corp. led to the natural dissolution of our relationship.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: I'm sorry. It's just that... It's hard to picture you being romantically involved with... anyone.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Our relationship entailed elements that are no different from what is conventionally expected from "romantic partners."
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: We went on dates and spent time together.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: ... Wait, do you hear that? Sounds like a pair of scissors.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: It might be worth checking out.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: This isn't where the noise is coming from, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: This isn't the way to the vendor, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Huh, looks like they're blocking the way through.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: <... Should we try talking to those things?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Excuse me, would you let us into the store behind you?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Meeting! So much meeting!
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: So no entry. No room for anything else.
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: What's the taste of meeting?
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: Salty, so salty. Salty like tears. Too salty for anyone to swallow.
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: Meeting won't end. Swallow meeting to end debate. But can't swallow.
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: ... So, what's this meeting about?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Agenda 1: Who is the outer fabric, and who is the lining?
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: Agenda 2: Who is the right hand, and who is the left hand?
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: Mmm, mmm. Good agendas. Let's write them both in the minutes.
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: Approaching them might be dangerous... Should we come back here later?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: <Let's do that.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <color=#cf0000>Desire. Then it shall be donned.</color>
<There's a Voice here, too... Though it's different from the one we heard earlier.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: According to Miss Jeanne, it seems like each faction has a... guiding "Voice," who is, in truth, a "Giant." This voice probably belongs to one of them, too.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: A classic manipulation tactic. It bolsters solidarity within a faction by instilling its population with the entrenched in-group-versus-out-group mentality.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Ah... I see your will and abide by it wholeheartedly. Today, once again, I will be honest with myself... and indulge in my desires.
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: I shall stand against all that seeks to stop us, that one day your Voice might reach me, too...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: ... Do I hear new customers? First thing I like to tell the first-timers on our floor is this: you'll find the apparel displayed here to have a much more generous proportion of the Golden Hide than the shops below us, who only include trace amounts just so they can technically claim to be selling Golden Hide-infused fabric. Please, don't hesitate to touch the garment—I'm sure your discerning hands will notice the difference in quality.
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: Look, her eyes...!
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Though the vendor was facing us, I only saw empty sockets where her eyes should've been.
She's also been... nailed to the ground.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <color=#cf0000>Fan your desires... The more you are donned... the higher shall your self ascend...</color>
I understand... These meager patches of the Golden Hide cannot sate your desires... In my stead, countless Rouges have ventured out to scour the Grand Magasin as I speak...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: People are really rallying around religion in here... I thought it was a pretty niche concept in the City.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: You still don't seem to understand that the religions of the City are... veiled.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Veiled?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: ... Outis's eyes seemed to be lingering on something that I couldn't see. She ignored my question, deep in thought.
She still does not whisper her Voice into my ears—I do not have the faith to hear it. Is it because I am nailed to the ground? Because I can no longer fulfill my duty of gathering the Golden Hide?
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: <color=#cf0000>Yearn and desire. Desire shall be your transformation and ascension.</color>
I don't understand how exactly this "Voice" works, but she's so desperate to hear it that it makes me wish it would speak to her again.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: The Voice she desires to hear will never speak to her again.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Meursault, who usually makes it a point never to deliver a judgment of his own, spoke with unexpected conclusiveness.
Well, how are you so sure about that?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: I know to whom that voice belongs.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <color=#cf0000>The vestments of Sisyphe gorge upon desire... gorge upon desire...</color>
Upon desire, and... Ahh, she's stopped again... Please don't stop... Speak to me again, please...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: You do? Yet another one?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Yes.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: That is my mother's voice.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <color=#cf0000>Sisyphe... Siiiisssyyyypphheeeeee...</color>
The Voice, it's... it's forsaken me again.
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: Why... Why...?!
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: The vendor jerks from side to side, but the nails firmly bind her to the ground.
So... Who did this to you?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: This is my punishment, for I was foolish enough to let my heart harbor doubt.
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: When I was deafened to her Voice, I questioned her—and paid the price dearly, rightly so.
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: My eyes would seek too widely, and my legs would travel too far in search of the whereabouts of the Voice... In their bottomless kindness, the Rouges of the higher floors affixed me to this store for the rest of eternity.
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: But I... I...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: I saw a short-lived glint of light reflect off something from behind the darkness of her empty eye sockets.
I must know why the Voice no longer tells me any new tales... Why she only repeats and repeats the same stories without end...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: This can't be right, can it? This isn't right, something's terribly wrong here... I've flayed the Golden Hide, torn apart and devoured the Noirs much more diligently than anyone else ever did... until they nailed me down...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: Dear strangers, I've a request... I'll give you every last eyeball I have left, and in return...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: ... would you go to the Public Address room for me? It's on this floor. No other place here carried her Voice with such volume and clarity... Maybe there, you'll find a clue to what happened to the Voice.
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: <Right... the people inside Sisyphe have no way of knowing that Meursault's mother... has already passed away.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Can you tell them that the "Voice" they worship has already—>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: I doubt the plain truth will be able to breach the walls of reality her adamant faith has built, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: So... May I suggest that we comply with her request for now? I presume we have much intelligence and eyeballs to gain from undertaking this task.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Sure, let's head to the PA room.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Do you need anything patched up?
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: ... The Alteration Shop sure is expensive.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Price gouging outsiders seems to be the norm everywhere these days.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <We're going to have to raise our Prestige Tier again if we want to rise to the next floor...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Those monsters down the corridor look pretty dangerous... Should we go the other way?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: They are not monsters. They are Two-piece.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Two-piece?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Maybe it's their name? Or their jobs in here...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Mm.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: In that case, perhaps we could earn some eyeballs from them. Or get some directions to where the shops are on this floor, at the very least.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Doooonnnn... The more you are doooonnneed...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: The being drones in a slow, dragging voice.
huge...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: There is a panel before this entity, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: 3F Floor Manager: Narrator of the Endless.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: There's... something inside that birdcage in their hand. I think it's an... audiotape?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: That audiotape might be able to answer the nailed Rouge's questions.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: The more you are doooonnneed...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: <Sounds like it wants something from us.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: ... It is mimicking.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: It is vaguely reminiscent of the words from the broadcasted Voice.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <I noticed that, too.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Let's think back to what the Voice said back in the nailed Rouge's shop...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The more you are doooonnneed...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: The more you are doooonnneed...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: ... the more shall your self become... your self become...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: Desire... Desiiiiirrrrreeeeeee... Then...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: It shall be donned... be donned...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: The vestments of Sisyphe... The vestmeeennnntsssss of... Sisypheeee...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: Gorge upon desire... upon desirrreeee...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: The birdcage dangling from its hand opens with a click.
Obtained "PA System Audiotape."
<I don't think that was the answer...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Strangers...! Strangerssssss...!!!
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: The audacity... The audacityyyy...!
The heap of fabric collapsed limply to the ground.
An opened birdcage rolls out from beneath the pile.
Obtained "PA System Audiotape".
... The broadcast has stopped.
texts.speaker: Ionesco

texts.text: Strangers, if I might ask...
texts.speaker: Ionesco

texts.text: Have you come in contact with the Rouge nailed to the ground and with her eyes removed?
texts.speaker: Ionesco

texts.text: ... What is it to you?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: There are those among us who... despair that the Voice has abandoned their ears. They have taken to condemning the pipes of the PA room for the silence, prodding them to no avail. It's all a rather profane affair.
texts.speaker: Ionesco

texts.text: The Voice is but one manifestation of faith; our duties remain all the same. We need only unwaveringly flay the Golden Hide the Grand Magasin has so generously granted us, so that we may weave and don it ourselves as raiments.
texts.speaker: Ionesco

texts.text: Those who desiderate for the Voice's reply fail to grasp that concept. The Voice exists not to give us faith, but to distinguish the faithless from the doubtful.
texts.speaker: Ionesco

texts.text: Though we may not be blessed with new tales now, our "Voice" will soon return our pleas. In a new, unprecedented form...
texts.speaker: Ionesco

texts.text: <A new form...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Apologies for the disturbance to your shopping experience. Please, enjoy your spending.
texts.speaker: Ionesco

texts.text: Hearing our footsteps, the vendor turns around to face us, fumbling a little as she does so.
Y-you're back... What did you find there, in the PA room? Did you find the answer to my questions?
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: We... found something, I guess, but...
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Of course... I knew there had to have been a reason! The Voice wouldn't withdraw her gaze from a devout Rouge like me... Not after I've committed my entire life and more to flaying the Golden Hide off the Grand Magasin...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: Oh... this is...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: Is everything... okay?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: You've brought me her Voice.
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: All this time, it was just a sentence uttered eons ago...? Playing in a loop... in a loop... in a loop...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: ... No, NO!
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: No, that can't be true. The Voice watches over me. This is just a test of my faith, that's all this is...!
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: Tsk. What a fool.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: I gave up my eyes for this? I let them nail me to the floor for this?! Only to be condemned to an eternity of waiting, for an answer that will never come...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: No, no... I must chant her mantra again, her Voice...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: Don... Desire... The more you are donnned... the moooorrreeee yooouuuu aarrreee dooonnnneeed...
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: The vendor slowly shrinks into herself until she's curled up into a fetal position.
Suddenly, strands of red hands sprout from her, enclosing her under layers upon layers of chiral membrane.
Wh-what...?!
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: The arms swell with it, interlocking into a complex network of hands embracing hands.
Enveloping her like a cocoon, insulating her from the tales of the outside.
The entities some refer to as "gods"... They tend to cast aside those who cling to them most desperately.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <... In the end, the truth was too much for her to accept.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: That opened the shop for us, but... I'm not sure if I like how we got here.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>Naturally. What you revealed to her is a truth that should never have come to light.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>That audiotape contains the truth the Rouges have tried to keep buried for many years.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>It reveals that they have only been deluding themselves into believing that a unique Voice personally whispered into each and every one of their ears...</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>... and that the Voice they have so fervently followed for so many years... was only an ancient recording playing on repeat.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>I don't know for sure, since I've never lived here myself, but...</color>

... that audiotape must've been recorded about... 10 years ago in Sisyphe's time. Or 200? Maybe it was 500 years ago, even—it doesn't matter. What matters is that it feels like an appropriately ancient recording to those inside.
<color=#ebcaa2>It's been playing on repeat for a long time, loop after loop... No wonder the tape's been stretched to its limits.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>Some of the high-tier Rouges in the Luxury Hall must've had their suspicions, I'm sure...</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>But they can't possibly say outright that the Voice their faction so fervently follows will never say anything new again—that their Giant has abandoned them, for all intents and purposes—when the Noirs are waiting with bated breath to gain the upper hand.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>Though, I'm sure dear Meursault wouldn't have any qualms telling them the truth as it is. Isn't that right?</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>There's no hiding the elephant in the room. The consequences of a Giant's disappearance are clear enough: cracks have formed in the walls of the Grand Magasin, and the departed no longer return.</color>
There's something I've been meaning to ask... Why do you call yourselves "Giants"?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Why do you think we call ourselves "Giants"?
Because you are pillars to something greater than yourselves.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>Sharp. Yes, the only things ensuring the continued existence of the Grand Magasin Sisyphe... are us. Without us shouldering the weight of this whole enterprise, its days are numbered.</color>
And there are multiple "Giants," naturally.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>Naturally. You think there's anyone in the world who can handle this all on their own? If there were...</color>
So what, is the Grand Magasin nothing more than a show to you? Every bizarreness, every absurdity just some entertainment for Giants to watch from the outside like it's none of your business?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>Not at all. In our eyes, every one of these sights is...</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>... nauseating and terrifying. Yes, I've always been so afraid of it all.</color>
<Afraid?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>Ah. I've got to go—something I need to be there for.</color>
She's gone quiet again.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: <I don't think we can go up to the fourth floor just yet... Do we have anywhere else to explore?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: How about we check the corridor to the right again, Manager?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: No meeting, however long, could possibly still be in session after all this time.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <That's true... Let's see if anything's changed.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The meeting. Is it still underway?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: The meeting? Still underway! Not over.
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: Right arm cast the dissenting vote...
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: ... and the outer fabric couldn't convince the lining.
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: ... I've frequently intercepted and deciphered coded messages during the War, but...
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: ... no matter how complex their ciphers were, we could rely on the inherent intent to "hide" something to start the decoding process.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <But for these two... this weird, coded way of speaking is just how they naturally communicate.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Perhaps torturing them would yield further opportunities to identify the patterns by which we may—
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: H-hang on, Outis. Let me try again.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: In that case... when will this "meeting" end?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: When?
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: When...?
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: When was it again?
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: When was the beginning, when is the ending?
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: ... Are you also starting to see the merits of torture, Manager?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Now you're getting it.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Might you be considering the same option that I am?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: I might be.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Hm. Good. I see that you're making quite the strides.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Wha... What? What are you two talking about?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Let us head to the Alteration Shop, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Welcome back, stranger with drooping shoulder seams.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: I could fix that in no time, stranger. I need only readjust the sewing on your jacket into a slightly loosened arrangement...
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: Um... Actually, I wanted to ask if we could purchase a pair of scissors from you? I see some that look pretty well-sharpened...
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: I can see the desire to go snip-snip! in your eyes. I like that look.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: I do have scissors, yes. But I can see in your eyes that the scissors on display aren't what interest you.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: Correct. The pair of scissors we need is of significant size.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: The pair of scissors I wield is not a tool I am willing to part with lightly, unless you were to offer me a great many eyeballs.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: Haven't you realized from our last visit that we aren't exactly flush with eyeballs? If you're making the same proposition anyway, then...
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: ... Ah, I see. You are inviting us to bargain.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Correct. For example... "amusement" can be a price.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: You there. That head of yours... how fascinating.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: She slowly turns toward Meursault.
Mind if I split open and dig around in your head a little bit? Let me do that, and I could give you a better deal for my pair of scissors.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: Split his head open?!
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Don't you worry, I am the best alterationist in all of the Grand Magasin. Burst seams? Ripped lining? Hand it to me, and I'll sew and patch them back to flawless perfection.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: Once I'm done looking, I could stitch your head back up without leaving so much as a loose thread. How's that?
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: Would've dismissed that claim without batting an eye had we been outside, but within Sisyphe, where events and communications are contingent not on their materiality but their symbolic significance...
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: This is unlikely to be an issue, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: It seems she only wants to take a look inside my head.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <Right, might as well.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Aha... So that's what you look like on the inside.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: Fascinating use of that element. So detailed and stiff! Almost like the collars of a well-ironed dress shirt.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text:
Oh, what's this here...? You've neatly folded and stored something deep and stubborn in this dark corner...
As curious as I am to see, it would be against the alterationist code to rummage through your drawers without consent. I'll keep that nicely shut.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: Thanks for the peek. Now sit still; I'll sew you right back up...

texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: That might be what we're looking at here, actually. Maybe there really isn't any difference between each iteration.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: The gaze that pierces an object straight down to its essence, unswayed by its surface-level label... No common person could have noticed such a subtle detail. I expected no less of our Executive Manager!
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <... These probably look the same to most people, though...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: It says [Off-Season / Prêt-à-porter]

It says [Off-Season / Prêt-à-porter].
Some price tags have been taped over. Must be on sale.
<Huh, look at the tags. Why are these clothes more expensive than the others?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: That is because the display you are looking at is for this season's Prêt-à-porter items.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <Prêt-à-porter?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: It refers to made-to-stock, ready-to-wear items; those of higher quality and prestige, in particular.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <Prestige but ready-to-wear, huh...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: I take a closer look with Meursault's explanation in mind... But I'm not entirely sure what's supposed to be so prestige and quality about these...
This couch is disturbingly shiny. Tried slumping down on it as one would on a normal couch, but it's so taut that it doesn't even feel like I'm sitting...
Obtained some eyeballs that were hidden between the cracks in the couch.
<color=#ebcaa2>... Aren't you a busy bee?</color>
The voice snaps me back to reality, and I realize I've been greedily pawing at the inside of the cash drawer.
<color=#ebcaa2>If you're that strapped for eyeballs... Why don't you go help the Mannequins exit the stage?</color>
Shuddering at the subtle contempt in her voice, I slam the cash register shut and quickly leave the scene.
Am I just blindly rummaging through these in hopes of finding a stroke of luck...?
[미사용] 빈약해 보이는 조명이다. 모빌 같기도 하다.
Cloth straps wrapped around the figure make a faint straining noise.
... Did it just smile? Probably just seeing things...
The description calls this a "formal suit", but it looks more like a straitjacket.
Something's watching from the dark hollows of its eye sockets...
Wait, the expression changed... A nameless terror crawls up my spine.
Is it in fashion to cover the face like that...?

This outfit is called [La Première Superposition].
Unlike the other articles of clothing here, this one has just one dangly bit on its arm. It's cheaper, too. It must be a more "affordable" version of the Signature collection on display.
Something's breathing from behind the fabric...
The Noirs at the checkout counter are wearing something similar to this outfit.

[La Troisieme Superposition. 
A fascinating blend of cape, frock coat, and jacket in a all-in-one integration. Highest prestige in this Season's collection.
Please visit the reception desk for pricing and reservations.]
... Looks like the outfit is pricier and rarer than it looks.

[La Troisieme Superposition. 
A fascinating blend of cape, frock coat, and jacket in a all-in-one integration. Highest prestige in this Season's collection.
Please visit the reception desk for pricing and reservations.]
[Prêt-à-porter. Contains 150% of the Golden Yarn compared to the Last Season's!]
Upon closer inspection, I notice that it contains only 0.00015% of the so-called "Golden Yarn." Doesn't seem anywhere near significant enough to warrant putting that on the advertisement.
Doesn't this mean that the last season's products had only 0.0001% Golden Yarn...?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: ... I'm willing to bet that Whale chips from U Corp. have more Whale in them than this has Golden Yarn.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: A display case full of glasses. Not sure how I'd go about wearing them, however.
... These are glasses, right...? The label above the display does say "glasses"...
On display are bizarrely normal-looking pairs of glasses and sunglasses that look distinctly out of place. Some of these look like Gregor's glasses.
Bizarrely normal-looking pairs of glasses and sunglasses that look out of place here. Surprisingly mundane, almost.
A combination of a stool and a drawer... A strawer. Looks like it fails at being either, though.
A combination of a stool and a drawer... A strawer. Found a handful of eyeballs in its drawer that somebody forgot.
A combination of a stool and a drawer... A strawer. Found a handful of eyeballs in its drawer that somebody forgot... not. A clock can hope, though.
Ah... You've returned. We've been waiting for you.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: Did you relay our message to the Noirs on the fourth floor?
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: We did.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Much appreciated... Did they have anything to say about it?
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: The Noirs on the fourth floor wanted us to deliver this to you.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Along with the note, we relayed what we learned from the fourth floor as the two Noirs listened anxiously.
Le Rouge, abandoned by their Voice, is conspiring within the Luxury Hall to give life to a new Voice...?
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: ... I see... And an implement made of "Nail" and Golden Fabric is needed if we're to have any hope of stopping their vile plan from coming to fruition.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: If it really is as the noble one on the upper floor says, then our path forward is clear. ... We can claim the Luxury Hall as Le Noir's by tearing apart that new "Voice" of theirs before it is born.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: ... I hate to ask again, but we are in need of your assistance once again, strangers.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: <Well... our goals seem to align anyway. We need those Luxury clothes from the second floor to be admitted to the fifth floor.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Our goals align.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: *sigh* Much obliged.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: We're not entirely unfamiliar with the Golden Fabric—we've even used it for some of our works, though we had to commission the Alterationist for it.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: The tricky part's going to be the Golden Skein, though... I have no idea where that's sourced from.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: According to the recipe on the note... we might be able to get it from some kind of cocoon.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: That means you're going to need the Golden Cocoon to obtain the Golden Skein. Flannel, where do people usually come by the cocoons?
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: The cocoon can be found on B1... Huh. The basement floors?
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: B1F...! I see, this journey will bring you to the subterranean floors. Then I presume you will be dealing with B2's Floor Manager as well... which answers the question concerning how the Golden Skein is to be spun.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: Uh... Is it dangerous down there?
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Not dangerous per se, but... certainly unique in its atmosphere.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: We have been down there a few times before, yes. But only to lay an early claim to the raw fibers... That place is, hm, you see, quite primal.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: Anyway, I suggest you explore B2 once you acquire the cocoon. B2's Floor Manager is a long-time collaborator of the Noirs, so I'm sure it'll all go smoothly as long as you bring the Authenticity Certificate with you.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: As for the "Nail"... A long piece of bone should do, but... which one? We'll have to think about it.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: I say it's about time we made use of that revolting Rouge on the other end of this floor. I've always thought her spinal cord would come in useful as a long nail.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: Neither is in our possession, nor have we seen anything like it before.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: It's going to be a very roundabout journey, with all the pieces scattered throughout the floors.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: And of course, we will be sure to compensate you handsomely with eyeballs.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: <Can you also ask them, once we're done carrying out their tasks, if they'll let us have some clothes from the second floor so we can get onto the fifth?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The Executive Manager would like to ask the two of you if this collaboration would secure us access to the fifth floor.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: I can't guarantee that, unfortunately, but... I promise that you will have Le Noir's eternal gratitude.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: It is not within my authority to grant you anything of the like, but I can write you another Authenticity Certificate for this collaboration, at the very least.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: I'll be sure to pull all the strings I have and put in as good a word as I can to the other Noirs.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: <... Good enough for me. Let's go.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: It's done. You may take this Golden Fabric and its brilliance with you.
texts.speaker: Annette

texts.text: <And now...we just need the "Nail" to complete this.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: According to the Noir employees, the Rouge vendor's... spinal cord... would make a decent long nail.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Hm... Well, let's go check up on her, then.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Should probably get this skein to the Alteration Shop as soon as possible.
Should probably visit the Rouge vendor.
<... I think her Distortion's getting worse...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <I can hear something from the inside. Muttering...>
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Witness the culmination of your choices. Events follow events without rhyme or reason in a vaguely-defined series of additions until, one day, it happens.
<color=#ebcaa2>This one's been squeezing herself into an ill-fitting outfit.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>Or maybe she's only now learned of her exact measurements? Familiarity's a powerful thing... It can acclimatize you to even the most uncomfortable of outfits.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>Remember, ma puce? The ill-fitting green dress I wore to our date. Remember how long I complained?</color>
Ripped the spine off the Rouge who'd stopped moving.
Ugh... didn't know it was this hard to remove a spine.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: ... So, this is what they meant by "nail"? A spine removed from a corpse?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: It is defined as a nail.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: We draped the Golden Fabric around the nail we took from the Rouge.
<So this is the legendary weapon capable of piercing any fabric, no matter its weave...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The snip-snip of the scissors have gone silent.
The corpse of a Noir. Even the fabric they took such pride in couldn't save them from this fate.
A [Prêt-à-porter] display rack.
Staring at it for too long is somehow exhausting.
It says [Origami CollectioN° 92, 2 of 5. Someone's fall sublimated into superpositioned time.]
A communication switchboard, as described by Outis.
That golden glow... You've really done it...
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: A mere "thank you" couldn't possibly express our gratitude, so we'll dispense with the formalities and get straight to the point.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: We Noirs will never forget the tremendous contribution you have made in service of our cause. Rest assured, your names will be forever etched on our VIP list, dear customers.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: Even I have never set foot in the Luxury Hall. I could look at it from a distance when we stopped by that floor, but they've never let us see what's inside.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: Whoever wants admittance is going to need to meet some stringent qualifications...
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: ... Which... I'm sorry to say, is a task that only customers like yourselves, who are unbound by the rules of each Floor, can complete.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: Those bereaved of the Voice believe they can weave themselves a new one, do they...? Preposterous. Ignorant and presumptuous to the bitter end, they are.
texts.speaker: Felt

texts.text: Make your preparations, and head to the Luxury Hall.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: Whatever it is they're planning... Utterly crush their resistance so that they may never even dream of attempting such a thing again.
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: Only then shall eternity come to the Grand Magasin... Held together by the Golden Resin...
texts.speaker: Flannel

texts.text: Heeeeaaaar.... it warbling...!
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: The Floor Manager rises from their pedestal. Time to end this.
!SHADOWED BATTLE!
Be sileeeeeeent... Be sileeeeeeent...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: Put your foolish desires... to rest...
texts.speaker: 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: <Damn, thought we dodged that.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: That enemy presents difficulties on multiple fronts... Its speed is one thing, but it has the uncanny ability to swerve at the last minute to follow Meursault's attempt to evade.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: I recommend using the environmental obstacles or employing more unpredictable evasive maneuvers.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <Do you think that'll work...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: I will attempt to evade as you command.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <... Yeah... my command's the part where I'm not so confident about. But fine, let's try this again.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Whoa. That thing blew up much sooner than I'd expected.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: We'll have to move away as soon as it begins to tremble.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: Try to stay more alert next time.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: It will be done.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: ... That wasn't a very pleasant noise.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Are you unhurt, Executive Manager?
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: <I'm a bit rattled by the noise, but... otherwise unhurt.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Meursault, on the other hand... got his head exploded.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: It felt as though something were slowly filling and inflating my head.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Hearing Meursault's placid description of that horrible death, Sinclair scratched the back of his head and awkwardly chimed in.
Ah... I'm glad I didn't have to go through that. Thanks for telling me to plug my ears, Miss Outis.
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: <That's good. Then... Let's take five and head out again.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: ... That thing ripped him in half the moment they came into contact.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: We may have to wait until their "meeting" is adjourned, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: Outis

texts.text: Honestly, those agendas didn't really seem all that important...
texts.speaker: Sinclair

texts.text: <Either way, let's steer clear of that thing until we find a way around it.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Meeting still underway!
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: The meeting must go on, they said!
texts.speaker: Two-piece

texts.text: Huh? What's happening? Who's hitting me?
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: Ooh... Voice, help me... Was becoming blinded and nailed not enough? Must I now be killed by the hands of an assailant who refuses me even the courtesy of telling me what I'm dying for?
texts.speaker: L'Inamovible

texts.text: It remains silent, enveloped under a cocoon of numerous hands.
